description: Update the timer color logic to ensure overdue timers (exceeding 100%) always display with red styling, taking precedence over warning states. This change needs to be applied consistently across all timer display components in the frontend.
functional_requirements: Reorder conditional checks so that the 'overdue' state (percentage > 100) is evaluated before the 'warning' state in all timer components
Ensure timers exceeding 100% completion always display with red styling (bg-red or text-red classes)
Maintain existing warning state logic (yellow styling) for timers between warning threshold and 100%
Apply consistent color priority logic across both TimerBar and TimerInlined components
